title: Encrypt an S3 Bucket
description: Enable default encryption and set a bucket policy to enforce HTTPS and encryption.
problemStatement:
## Scenario
You have a production S3 bucket named `acme-financial-reports`. You need to ensure:
- All new objects are encrypted at rest using SSE‑KMS with a specific CMK.
- Any upload attempt that does not specify server‑side encryption is denied.
- Only HTTPS requests are allowed (deny requests that use HTTP).

### Your Task
Write the bucket policy (JSON) that accomplishes all three requirements. You may assume the KMS key ARN is `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1234abcd`.

Also, write a short description (2-3 sentences) explaining how default encryption and the policy work together.
hints: Use a Deny effect with a condition checking s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption and aws:SecureTransport.
Default encryption handles objects uploaded without specifying encryption, but the policy is an extra enforcement layer.
expectedOutput: A JSON bucket policy with two statements: one denying PutObject if encryption header is missing or not 'aws:kms', and another denying requests where aws:SecureTransport is false. Plus explanation.
